At closing, a guide to gate calls
This article helps

Travel checks for pets at the end of day

As the shift coordinator, I want this guide to stay calm and practical for travelers bringing a pet on Aurelia Skyways. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and careful preparation helps the Companion Animal Travel Desk support your plans without last-minute stress.

Before you travel, make sure the carrier is secure, clean, and easy for staff to inspect. A pet should be able to stand, turn, and rest naturally inside the crate. For cat travel, <<FACT F067>> Do not add bedding or accessories that block ventilation or make the crate hard to open.

For bird travel, <<FACT F065>> Keep the carrier stable and protected from sudden movement, and avoid covering it in a way that traps heat or reduces airflow. If your pet seems uneasy, allow extra calm time before check-in and keep handling gentle.

At the desk, have your travel documents ready and keep your pet close under control. If you are traveling with more than one animal, speak clearly with the staff so each case is reviewed in order. Priya Mori and Felix Wilson can expect the same steady process as any other traveler, and Ranger should be kept comfortable and secure throughout the handoff.

If you need to change plans, tell the desk as soon as possible so we can review the route and the pet space available. We may also ask you to confirm the crate fit, the species, and the condition of the animal before we approve travel. Clear information helps us reduce delays and keeps the journey smoother for everyone involved.

When your check-in is complete, stay nearby until you receive final direction from staff. More help is available from the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
